title: AutoMaster: Autonomous Post-Training by Making the Same Model a Better Teacher
title_zh: AutoMaster：让同一模型成为更好的教师，实现自主后训练
abstract_en: Task success alone does not specify which behaviors post-training should reinforce. Even successful teacher trajectories can contain unsupported assumptions, unproductive repetition, or superficial verification. We propose Skill-FT (Skill-Guided Fine-Tuning), which uses natural-language skills to suppress undesirable habits and elicit underrepresented effective behaviors during teacher rollouts, then fine-tunes a student model on the resulting trajectories. We introduce AutoMaster, an autonomous post-training system in which an LLM agent develops these interventions through trajectory analysis, skill design, data selection, and feedback from rollouts and evaluation. Across Terminal, Search, and software engineering tasks with 4B and 9B student models, AutoMaster improves mean performance over Vanilla SFT on successful unguided teacher trajectories by 1.42-8.99 percentage points, with the teacher, task pool, training set size, and SFT recipe held fixed. Together with the ablations and trajectory analyses, these results suggest that behavioral shaping can make a fixed model a more effective teacher. We further find that retaining skill instructions during SFT yields higher mean performance than removing them across all six settings, despite their absence at evaluation and identical supervised outputs. These findings suggest that preserving skill context as part of a training demonstration can support better behavioral internalization.
abstract_zh: 任务成功并不意味着执行过程中的所有行为都值得强化。即使教师模型成功完成任务，其轨迹仍可能包含无依据的假设、无效重复或流于表面的验证。论文提出 Skill-FT（Skill-Guided Fine-Tuning），在教师模型生成轨迹时用自然语言技能指令抑制不良习惯、引出原本较少出现的有效行为，再用这些轨迹微调学生模型。自主后训练系统 AutoMaster 由 LLM 智能体分析轨迹、设计技能指令、筛选数据，并根据轨迹生成和评估反馈调整干预。在覆盖 Terminal、Search 和软件工程任务的六种实验设置中，使用 4B 和 9B 学生模型时，AutoMaster 相比在无技能引导的成功轨迹上训练的 Vanilla SFT，平均表现提高了 1.42–8.99 个百分点；教师模型、任务池、训练集大小以及 SFT 配置均保持不变。此外，在监督输出完全相同、评估时不提供技能指令的条件下，训练时保留技能指令在全部六种设置中都优于移除指令，表明保留示范中的技能上下文有助于学生模型内化目标行为。
key_points_zh: 任务成功不等于轨迹优质：只筛选成功轨迹，仍可能把无依据的假设、无效重复和敷衍验证教给学生。
Skill-FT 在教师生成轨迹时用自然语言技能指令引导行为；AutoMaster 则自动完成轨迹分析、技能设计、数据筛选与反馈迭代。
固定教师模型、任务池、训练集大小和 SFT 配置后，AutoMaster 相比 Vanilla SFT 的平均表现提升 1.42–8.99 个百分点。
即使监督输出相同且评估时不提供技能指令，训练时保留技能上下文仍在全部六种设置中表现更好。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: AutoMaster 根据轨迹分析、试运行和评估反馈设计技能与筛选数据，再用技能引导的轨迹更新学生代理的参数。相对无技能引导的 SFT，受控比较显示平均表现提升 1.42–8.99 个百分点；六种设置均支持训练时保留技能指令。摘录未显示生成、筛选或验证后续改进的机制本身得到改进，因此不标 RSI。
